subject.title: agent-core: parallel batch runs a prepared paid tool after the run is aborted mid-batch

question: Which linked candidate PR should maintainers land for the prepared parallel-tool abort race?
rationale: Two open PRs close this issue and touch the same agent-core boundary; one has stronger real behavior proof, and closing the issue before a merge would leave the shipped bug unresolved.

options.title: Land the proof-positive candidate
options.body: Proceed with maintainer review of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102276, then close or supersede the duplicate candidate after one fix merges.

options.title: Choose the duplicate candidate instead
options.body: Keep both paths open only until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102283 supplies comparable proof or maintainers explicitly prefer its implementation details.

options.title: Pause both for a different design
options.body: Hold both PRs if maintainers want a broader cancellation architecture than the shared `executePreparedToolCall` guard.

recommendation.title: Land the proof-positive candidate
recommendation.body: Proceed with maintainer review of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102276, then close or supersede the duplicate candidate after one fix merges.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the clearest current owner signal for the packaged agent-core loop and adjacent abort work, so they are the best available routing owner for choosing the landing path.
